segments.ja285:1.3: Haññāma [hañchema (sī. pī.), hañchāma (?)] maṇino ābhaṃ, iti no mantanaṃ ahu.
segments.ja285:2.1: Yāvatā maṇiṃ ghaṃsāma [yāva yāva nighaṃsāma (sī. pī.)], bhiyyo vodāyate maṇi;
segments.ja285:2.3: Idañca dāni pucchāma, kiṃ kiccaṃ idha maññasi.
segments.ja285:3.1: Ayaṃ maṇi veḷūriyo, akāco vimalo [vipulo (ka.)] subho;
segments.ja285:3.3: Nāssa sakkā siriṃ hantuṃ, apakkamatha sūkarāti.

lines: Idañcadāni pucchāmāti idāni mayaṃ “kena kāraṇena ayaṃ maṇi kilissamāno vodāyate”ti idaṃ taṃ pucchāma.
“Kiṃ kiccaṃ ‘idha maññasī’ti imasmiṃ atthe tvaṃ imaṃ kiccaṃ kinti maññasī”ti.
Atha nesaṃ ācikkhanto bodhisatto tatiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Nāssa sakkā siriṃ hantuṃ, apakkamatha sūkarā”ti.
Apakkamathāti imassa maṇissa pabhā nāsetuṃ na sakkā, tumhe pana imaṃ maṇiguhaṃ pahāya aññattha gacchathāti.
